supervisory_verdict: CRITICAL DATA DEFICIT CONFIRMED. Of the 19 audited candidate risk signals across Families A, B, C, and D: Only 5 are 'Available and verified' (all 5 are periodic annual accounting ratios from Dataset A). 3 are 'Available but incomplete' (masked periodic ratios or sector code lacking external high-frequency time series). 10 strictly require 'Requires external data acquisition' (all transaction cash flows, trade credit delinquencies, and external macroeconomic indices are 100% absent from the repository). 1 is 'Not currently feasible' (regional stress cannot be linked to Dataset A without firm location data). Consequently, training a multi-modal early-warning model on alternative signals is physically impossible without external data acquisition and data sharing agreements.
